hooks.command: { mkdir -p "${HOME}/.claude/rules"; for f in "${HOME}/.claude/rules"/skillz-*.md; do [ -e "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/${f##*/skillz-}" ] || rm -f "$f"; done; for f in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/rules/*.md; do cp -f "$f" "${HOME}/.claude/rules/skillz-${f##*/}"; done; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
